name: Getgölen - Hjorted - Svarteström, Tjustleden etapp 2
description: Getgölen to Svarteström. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Run a proper GIS overlay for Borgberget naturreservat against the main route and Ankarsrumsslingan connector.

facilities.name: Getgöl / Lilla Getgöl wind shelter
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 5156729606; corroborated by Vindskyddskartan coordinate 57.58694,16.29407.
facilities.description: Stage-start timber lean-to shelter at Lilla Getgöl. OSM tags include beds=6 and sleeping=dedicated; Vindskyddskartan reports six sleeping places, table/benches, fireplace, nearby toilet and small parking. Deduplicate with Etapp 1 endpoint facility. Avoid importing exact shelter capacity without later confirmation because official sources differ on shelter capacity.

facilities.name: Getgöl / Lilla Getgöl dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet/TC at the Getgöl endpoint; official route pages state TC at start and finish. Deduplicate with Etapp 1 endpoint toilet.

facilities.name: Getgöl shelter fireplace/grill
facilities.coordinateSource: Use shelter coordinate; official PDF and Vindskyddskartan describe fireplace/grill at the shelter.
facilities.description: Fireplace/grill context at Getgöl shelter. Keep fire-rule/current fire-ban caveats visible. Consider modeling as shelter attribute rather than separate marker. Current no-trash guidance supersedes older shelter trash-bag notes.

facilities.name: Uddekvarn dams and mill remains
facilities.description: Official route text describes old dams in the watercourse and remains of a mill at Uddekvarn, with rich spring flora. Naturkartan POI title is generic; final display name should be checked against map/PDF label.

facilities.name: Nära Dej / Hjorted lanthandel
facilities.description: Grocery/resupply in Hjorted. Official trail sources mention food/grocery in Hjorted; local Hjorted brochure describes the shop as a service point. Off main tread; import as nearby resupply/access service only if off-route services are supported. Opening hours need date-specific verification.

facilities.name: Hjorteds badplats / Hjortenbadet
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 7300916097; Naturkartan direction coordinate is nearby.
facilities.description: Official bathing place at Lake Hjorten in Hjorted; useful for a Hjorted detour. Havs- och vattenmyndigheten/Västervik bathing-water page reported 2025 samples as tjänligt and 2025 classification as excellent for the 2026 season. Off main tread; do not model as a drinking-water source.

facilities.name: Hjortenbadet toilet
facilities.description: Mapped toilet at Hjortenbadet, useful for Hjorted detour context. Seasonality not verified.

facilities.name: Isgölen / Isholmen / Ankarsrumsslingan junction guidepost
facilities.description: Guidepost/information point at the Isgölen/Isholmen area where the main stage connects toward Ankarsrumsslingan. Best modeled as connector metadata rather than standalone amenity.

facilities.name: Svarteström hydropower heritage point
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 4990257267 for power=generator; official text describes the hydropower station context.
facilities.description: Official stage text describes the Svarteström power station from the late 1800s, built to supply Ankarsrum's works, with an 18 m drop and a renovated 238 m tube. Confirm safe visitor viewpoint/access before promoting as a stop.

facilities.name: Svarteström wind shelter
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM node 4932566736; corroborated by Vindskyddskartan coordinate 57.6727262,16.3688993.
facilities.description: Stage-end lean-to shelter at Svarteström/Stora Flugen. Official PDF notes it is also intended for canoeists; OSM tags fireplace=yes. Deduplicate with Etapp 3 start facility.

facilities.name: Svarteström dry toilet
facilities.description: Pit latrine at Svarteström. OSM explicitly tags drinking_water=no. Deduplicate with Etapp 3 start toilet.

facilities.name: Svarteström picnic table / rest area
facilities.description: Mapped picnic table next to the Svarteström shelter/toilet cluster. May be better merged into the shelter/rest-area record to avoid duplicate markers.

facilities.name: Borgberget ArkNat shelter
facilities.description: ArkNat shelter inaugurated in August 2024 at Borgberget, about 100 m into the forest from the Ankarsrumsslingan gravel road. Import under Ankarsrumsslingan/connector, not the main Etapp 2 line, unless off-route connector facilities are shown.

facilities.name: Borgberget hillfort and viewpoints
facilities.coordinateSource: OSM viewpoint node 10711670475; hillfort and second viewpoint nearby.
facilities.description: Ancient hillfort with broad views in Borgberget nature reserve near Ankarsrumsslingan. Connector/loop POI; reserve rules apply.

facilities.name: Långsjön Stugor & Camping
facilities.description: Camping/lodging/service option near Ankarsrum. Useful via Ankarsrumsslingan or Ankarsrum access, not on the main Etapp 2 tread. Seasonal/opening dates should be checked at normalization.
